hints.text: Multiplying by $100$ makes a number $100$ times bigger, so the decimal point moves to the right.
$100$ has two zeros, so slide the point two places right: $3.6 \to 36. \to 360.$

explanation: $100 = 10^2$, so multiplying by it shifts the decimal point two places to the right.
Starting at $3.6$, one shift gives $36$ and a second shift gives $360$ — you fill the empty spot with a zero.
